metadata.name: IdamBox CSRM Role, Function and FunctionApi Catalogue

designNotes: Functions are created once per unique menuPath. Dashboard:Dashboard and Risk Assessment Requests:Request Details are shared by both roles because those exact menu paths appear for both roles.

Questionnaire:Questionnaire Details and Questionnaires:Questionnaire Details are separate Function records because the source document uses different menu groupings for Requestor and Security Analyst.

Risk Register mitigation-control screens use CsrmControlImplementation because this entity represents a control contextualized for a particular CsrmRisk. Administration control screens use CsrmControl because it represents the reusable control catalogue.
API paths are proposed application APIs inferred from the UI functions and JDL model; they are not existing endpoints declared by the JDL.

The JDL does not currently contain an explicit assessment release flag or release date. The proposed release endpoint requires either a new field/state or a separate publication record to enforce Requestor read-only visibility after release.

The JDL does not contain persisted Alert, ReportDefinition, Attachment, Comment, or Activity/Audit entities. The proposed report and alert endpoints may initially be computed services; persisted workflow collaboration, file uploads, alerts, and audit history require model extensions.

roles.name: Security Analyst
roles.description: Reviews and manages cyber risk assessment requests and questionnaires; creates, edits, approves, and releases risk assessments; manages the risk register, mitigation control implementations, risk and control catalogues, reports, and alerts.

roles.name: Requestor
roles.description: Creates and submits cyber risk assessment requests, collaborates on request details, completes assigned questionnaires, and views risk assessments after they have been released by a Security Analyst.

functions.name: Dashboard
functions.description: Shows role-aware workload summaries, risk and control metrics, report tiles, and current alerts.

functions.name: My Requests
functions.description: Lists cyber risk assessment requests created by the signed-in Requestor, with status, dates, and next actions.

functions.name: New Request
functions.description: Creates a structured assessment request and associates the relevant information systems, information assets, sponsor, and business context.

functions.name: Request Details
functions.description: Displays and, when permitted by workflow state and role, edits a risk assessment request and its associated systems and assets.

functions.name: My Questionnaires
functions.description: Lists questionnaires assigned to the signed-in Requestor through their assessment requests.

functions.name: Questionnaire Details
functions.description: Allows a Requestor to review generated questions, save answers, and submit the completed questionnaire.

functions.name: My Risk Assessments
functions.description: Lists risk assessments associated with the Requestor's requests that are available for Requestor viewing.

functions.name: Risk Assessment Details (Read Only)
functions.description: Shows a released risk assessment, its identified risks, and related mitigation controls without allowing the Requestor to modify them.

functions.name: Requests
functions.description: Lists all assessment requests available to Security Analysts for triage, review, and workflow processing.

functions.name: Questionnaires
functions.description: Lists generated questionnaires and their associated requests for Security Analyst review.

functions.name: Questionnaire Details
functions.description: Allows a Security Analyst to review questionnaire responses, record question-level comments, complete review, and initiate assessment drafting.

functions.name: Risk Assessments
functions.description: Lists generated and manually managed risk assessments for analyst review, approval, and release.

functions.name: Risk Assessment Details
functions.description: Allows a Security Analyst to review and edit an assessment, manage its contextualized risks, progress workflow status, approve it, and release it to the Requestor.

functions.name: Risk Register
functions.description: Lists contextualized risks across assessments with ratings, owners, treatment status, and target dates.

functions.name: Risk Details
functions.description: Displays and edits a contextualized risk, its affected systems or assets, owners, ratings, treatment plan, and mitigation controls.

functions.name: Mitigation Controls
functions.description: Lists contextual control implementations used to mitigate identified risks, including owner, status, effectiveness, evidence, and due dates.

functions.name: Mitigation Control Details
functions.description: Displays and edits one contextual mitigation control implementation, including owner, status, effectiveness, evidence, and delivery dates.

functions.name: Risk Types
functions.description: Lists and creates reusable risk definitions used by the AI and analysts to contextualize risks within assessments.

functions.name: Risk Type Details
functions.description: Displays and edits a reusable risk definition and its applicable control catalogue mappings.

functions.name: Controls
functions.description: Lists and creates reusable control definitions that may be selected as mitigation controls for contextualized risks.

functions.name: Control Details
functions.description: Displays and edits a reusable control definition and shows where it is applied.

functions.name: Reports
functions.description: Provides aggregated reporting over requests, questionnaires, assessments, risks, owners, treatments, and mitigation controls.

functions.name: Alerts
functions.description: Shows operational and risk alerts derived from overdue work, high residual risk, ineffective controls, and upcoming treatment or review dates.

functionApis.name: Get Dashboard Summary
functionApis.description: Returns role-aware summary counts and key performance indicators for the current user.

functionApis.name: Get Dashboard Reports
functionApis.description: Returns the report tiles and chart data visible to the current role.

functionApis.name: Get Dashboard Alerts
functionApis.description: Returns current role-aware alerts such as overdue assessments, risks, and mitigation actions.

functionApis.name: List My Assessment Requests
functionApis.description: Returns the signed-in Requestor's assessment requests with filtering, sorting, and pagination.

functionApis.name: Get My Request Status Summary
functionApis.description: Returns counts of the signed-in Requestor's requests grouped by request status.

functionApis.name: Get Assessment Request Form Metadata
functionApis.description: Returns enumerations, classifications, and other reference values required to render the request form.

functionApis.name: Search Information Systems
functionApis.description: Searches existing information systems that may be associated with the request.

functionApis.name: Search Information Assets
functionApis.description: Searches existing information assets that may be associated with the request.

functionApis.name: Search Users
functionApis.description: Searches users who may be selected as the request sponsor, system owner, or another referenced owner.

functionApis.name: Create Assessment Request
functionApis.description: Creates a new draft assessment request for the signed-in Requestor.

functionApis.name: Update Draft Assessment Request
functionApis.description: Saves changes to an assessment request while it remains editable.

functionApis.name: Add Request Information System
functionApis.description: Creates or associates an information system with the assessment request.

functionApis.name: Add Request Information Asset
functionApis.description: Creates or associates an information asset with the assessment request.

functionApis.name: Submit Assessment Request
functionApis.description: Submits the completed draft request and transitions it to the submitted workflow state.

functionApis.name: Get Assessment Request
functionApis.description: Returns the complete assessment request, requestor, sponsor, associated systems, assets, questionnaire, and assessment references.

functionApis.name: Update Assessment Request
functionApis.description: Updates request fields when the current role and workflow state permit editing.

functionApis.name: List Request Information Systems
functionApis.description: Returns information systems associated with the request.

functionApis.name: List Request Information Assets
functionApis.description: Returns information assets associated with the request.

functionApis.name: Submit Assessment Request
functionApis.description: Submits an editable request for analyst processing.

functionApis.name: Generate Request Questionnaire
functionApis.description: Invokes the agentic workflow to analyse the request context and generate or refresh its questionnaire.

functionApis.name: List My Questionnaires
functionApis.description: Returns questionnaires associated with assessment requests created by the signed-in Requestor.

functionApis.name: Get My Questionnaire Summary
functionApis.description: Returns questionnaire workload counts derived from the request workflow states.

functionApis.name: Get Questionnaire
functionApis.description: Returns the questionnaire header, its related assessment request, and completion context.

functionApis.name: List Questionnaire Questions
functionApis.description: Returns ordered questions, answer types, options, existing answers, help text, and review comments.

functionApis.name: Save Questionnaire Answers
functionApis.description: Creates or updates the Requestor's answers without submitting the questionnaire.

functionApis.name: Submit Questionnaire
functionApis.description: Submits the completed questionnaire for Security Analyst review and advances the request workflow.

functionApis.name: List My Released Risk Assessments
functionApis.description: Returns risk assessments associated with the signed-in Requestor's requests that have been released for viewing.

functionApis.name: Get My Assessment Rating Summary
functionApis.description: Returns counts and rating summaries for the Requestor's visible risk assessments.

functionApis.name: Get Released Risk Assessment
functionApis.description: Returns a released assessment only when it is associated with the signed-in Requestor's request.

functionApis.name: List Assessment Risks
functionApis.description: Returns all risks belonging to the released assessment.

functionApis.name: List Risk Mitigation Controls
functionApis.description: Returns contextual mitigation control implementations for an assessment risk.

functionApis.name: List Assessment Requests
functionApis.description: Returns assessment requests with role-authorized filtering, sorting, search, and pagination.

functionApis.name: Get Assessment Request Status Summary
functionApis.description: Returns request counts grouped by workflow status and due-date state.

functionApis.name: Get Overdue Assessment Requests
functionApis.description: Returns submitted or in-progress requests whose due dates have passed.

functionApis.name: List Questionnaires
functionApis.description: Returns questionnaires with associated request details and workflow-derived review state.

functionApis.name: Get Questionnaire Review Summary
functionApis.description: Returns questionnaire workload counts derived from related assessment request statuses.

functionApis.name: Get Questionnaire For Review
functionApis.description: Returns the questionnaire and its associated assessment request for analyst review.

functionApis.name: List Questionnaire Questions For Review
functionApis.description: Returns ordered questions, answers, answer metadata, and existing analyst review comments.

functionApis.name: Update Questionnaire Review Comments
functionApis.description: Updates question-level review comments entered by the Security Analyst.

functionApis.name: Complete Questionnaire Review
functionApis.description: Marks the questionnaire review as complete and advances the related assessment request workflow.

functionApis.name: Generate Initial Risk Assessment
functionApis.description: Invokes the agentic workflow to create an initial assessment and contextualized risks from the request and reviewed questionnaire.

functionApis.name: List Risk Assessments
functionApis.description: Returns risk assessments with request, reviewer, status, rating, and review-date information.

functionApis.name: Get Risk Assessment Status Summary
functionApis.description: Returns assessment counts grouped by assessment status and rating.

functionApis.name: Get Assessments Due For Review
functionApis.description: Returns assessments whose next review date is due or overdue.

functionApis.name: Get Risk Assessment
functionApis.description: Returns the assessment, linked request, questionnaire references, analyst assignments, and summary information.

functionApis.name: Update Risk Assessment
functionApis.description: Updates editable assessment summary, rationale, rating, recommendations, dates, and workflow fields.

functionApis.name: List Assessment Risks
functionApis.description: Returns all contextualized risks associated with the assessment.

functionApis.name: Create Assessment Risk
functionApis.description: Creates an additional contextualized risk within the assessment.

functionApis.name: Regenerate Assessment Draft
functionApis.description: Invokes the agentic workflow to regenerate proposed assessment content without automatically approving it.

functionApis.name: Submit Assessment For Approval
functionApis.description: Transitions the assessment from draft to in-review status.

functionApis.name: Approve Risk Assessment
functionApis.description: Approves the reviewed assessment and records the approving analyst and approval date.

functionApis.name: Release Risk Assessment To Requestor
functionApis.description: Releases an approved assessment for read-only visibility by the associated Requestor.

functionApis.name: List Risks
functionApis.description: Returns contextualized risks with filtering, sorting, search, and pagination.

functionApis.name: Get Risk Register Summary
functionApis.description: Returns risk counts grouped by inherent rating, residual rating, treatment status, and ownership.

functionApis.name: Get Overdue Risks
functionApis.description: Returns risks with overdue target or treatment resolution dates.

functionApis.name: Export Risk Register
functionApis.description: Exports the current authorized and filtered risk register view.

functionApis.name: Get Risk
functionApis.description: Returns the contextualized risk and its type, assessment, owners, and impacted system or asset.

functionApis.name: Update Risk
functionApis.description: Updates risk statements, ratings, rationale, owners, treatment action, status, dates, exemption, and escalation information.

functionApis.name: List Risk Mitigation Controls
functionApis.description: Returns all contextual control implementations linked to the risk.

functionApis.name: Add Risk Mitigation Control
functionApis.description: Creates a contextual control implementation linking a reusable control to the risk.

functionApis.name: Close Risk
functionApis.description: Closes a completed risk and records its closure date subject to validation of treatment state.

functionApis.name: List Control Implementations
functionApis.description: Returns contextual mitigation controls with related risk, reusable control, owner, status, effectiveness, and dates.

functionApis.name: Get Control Implementation Summary
functionApis.description: Returns mitigation control counts grouped by status, effectiveness, ownership, and due-date state.

functionApis.name: Get Overdue Control Implementations
functionApis.description: Returns planned or incomplete control implementations whose implementation due dates have passed.

functionApis.name: Create Control Implementation
functionApis.description: Creates a contextual mitigation control linked to a risk and reusable control definition.

functionApis.name: Get Control Implementation
functionApis.description: Returns a contextual mitigation control with its reusable control definition, related risk, and control owner.

functionApis.name: Update Control Implementation
functionApis.description: Updates status, effectiveness, evidence, owner, implementation date, due date, and review date.

functionApis.name: Delete Control Implementation
functionApis.description: Removes an incorrectly created contextual control implementation subject to authorization and audit rules.

functionApis.name: Get Reusable Control Definition
functionApis.description: Returns the reusable control catalogue record referenced by the implementation.

functionApis.name: List Risk Types
functionApis.description: Returns reusable risk definitions with filtering, search, sorting, and pagination.

functionApis.name: Create Risk Type
functionApis.description: Creates a reusable risk definition for use in future assessments.

functionApis.name: Get Risk Type
functionApis.description: Returns a reusable risk definition and its applicable controls.

functionApis.name: Update Risk Type
functionApis.description: Updates the reusable risk definition's name and description.

functionApis.name: Delete Risk Type
functionApis.description: Deletes an unused risk type subject to referential-integrity checks.

functionApis.name: List Applicable Controls
functionApis.description: Returns reusable controls mapped as applicable to the risk type.

functionApis.name: Replace Applicable Controls
functionApis.description: Replaces the set of reusable controls mapped as applicable to the risk type.

functionApis.name: List Controls
functionApis.description: Returns reusable controls with filtering, search, sorting, and pagination.

functionApis.name: Create Control
functionApis.description: Creates a reusable control definition in the control catalogue.

functionApis.name: Get Control
functionApis.description: Returns a reusable control definition and reference information.

functionApis.name: Update Control
functionApis.description: Updates the reusable control definition's number, name, description, type, and reference.

functionApis.name: Delete Control
functionApis.description: Deletes an unused reusable control subject to referential-integrity checks.

functionApis.name: List Control Implementations
functionApis.description: Returns contextual implementations that reference the reusable control.

functionApis.name: List Applicable Risk Types
functionApis.description: Returns reusable risk types to which the control is mapped.

functionApis.name: List Available Reports
functionApis.description: Returns report definitions that the Security Analyst is authorized to run.

functionApis.name: Run Report
functionApis.description: Returns data for a selected report using supplied filters and grouping parameters.

functionApis.name: Export Report
functionApis.description: Generates an export of a selected report in the requested supported format.

functionApis.name: List Alerts
functionApis.description: Returns generated or persisted alerts visible to the Security Analyst.

functionApis.name: Get Alert Summary
functionApis.description: Returns alert counts grouped by severity, source, status, and due-date state.

functionApis.name: Get Alert
functionApis.description: Returns the alert detail and references to the source assessment, risk, request, or control implementation.

functionApis.name: Acknowledge Alert
functionApis.description: Marks an alert as acknowledged by the signed-in Security Analyst.
